audience.text: Builders, architects, developers in Orange County? This one's for you.

problem.text: Land to keys takes four-plus years. And one missing document could delay a project by months, and cause real financial losses.

purpose.text: HouseX checks your plan set against Irvine's permit rules, before you submit.

demo.text: Add your address and plans. In under two minutes, you get the missing documents and code conflicts, each with its source.

payoff.text: Fewer correction rounds. Fewer months of loan interest. Fewer consulting fees. That's HouseX.
